note: Mutants of the cap of pairs of a plant and a waypoint of an online room's map (OnlineLimits::kMaxPlantWaypointPairs = 1,000,000), for tools/mutate.py (docs/WORKFLOW.md, 'Mutation checks'). Run from the checkout with a configured build folder: python3 tools/mutate.py tests/data/online_pairs_cap_mutants.json --keep-going --jobs 1 --timeout 1500. Every mutant must be caught: each breaks the cap or the counter (OnlineLimits::plant_waypoint_pairs, the same plants and the same waypoints that SimulationEngine::init's set-up loop counts) or removes the refusal at one door. The web side (the Play this map dialog's refusal and its MAX_ONLINE_PAIRS) is in tests/data/mapmaker_play_mutants.json (play_pairs_*); the shared allows()/listed_name()/online_refusal() code that the ants cap and the pairs cap both go through has its own pairs-forgetting mutants beside the ants ones, in online_ants_cap_mutants.json and online_limit_mutants.json. Not listed on purpose: the same second locks behind a first one that online_ants_cap_mutants.json's own note names (Room::start_lobby and the lobby's START in Room::update, behind choose_map, load_map and build_room: no door of the manager makes a Room on a map over the cap, so no test can start one; the feeder's own load_level is covered by MP2.5 and MP2.6 instead); the counter's predicate against the tile id (not the record's team) has its own full pin, every tile id, in test_lvl_core's C13, which lvl_core.cpp's own small copy of the dropper-plant list must agree with (OnlineLimits::plant_waypoint_pairs uses sim::movement::is_dropper_plant_tile directly, so this counter and that pin share one answer for every id; no map of the fixtures used here tells a plant from a same-team non-plant record, so a mutant that confused the two would not be caught by a map alone).
